proof_policy: Complete occurrence accounting against current retail 12.1.0 with 23 chronological later registers. Publication sweep 66 OK / 27 exact gaps; three unused namespace retirements. Pending substantive extracts receive no runtime credit. Local targeted evidence is not native or independent acceptance.
